verdict.rationale: Cua's docs describe a short bring-up path: install the driver once, add it to your agent and ask it to do things. They also document `cua runtime doctor`/`setup` to install missing pieces and a one-command taskset run. A hands-on community report contradicts this: across three attempts the user never got a clean first task, with one run typing in the wrong place and two failing to connect to the Computer API Server WebSocket. That report is on an older version (cua-agent 0.1.29). Missing for 10: an explicit step-by-step quickstart document, independent confirmation that a first task completes from the docs alone, and evidence the reported connection failures are fixed in current versions.

support.subject: As a developer, I get from install to a first completed device task using the quickstart docs alone

citations.quote: You install it once, add it to your agent, and then ask the agent to do things in your apps.
`cua runtime doctor` shows what this host has and `cua runtime setup` installs what is missing
Start from a taskset in the Cua Bench registry: one command runs it on this machine.
